mapper.select: select distinct m.id, m.menu_name, m.parent_id, m.path, m.icon, m.sort, m.type from sys_menu m join sys_role_menu rm on m.id = rm.menu_id join sys_user_role ur on rm.role_id = ur.role_id where ur.user_id = #{userId} order by m.sort asc
